preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 400 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(4 <= n <= 2**16 and n & (n - 1) == 0 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each n is a power of 2 between 4 and 2^16 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n - 1 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each k is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, k in test_cases) <= 2**16
preconditions.description: The sum of all n over all test cases does not exceed 2^16.

postconditions.expression: all(len(pairs) == n // 2 for n, k, pairs in results if pairs != -1)
postconditions.description: For each test case with a solution, the number of pairs is exactly n/2.

postconditions.expression: all(all(a != b and 0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n for a, b in pairs) for n, k, pairs in results if pairs != -1)
postconditions.description: For each test case with a solution, each pair contains distinct elements within the range [0, n-1].

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a & b for a, b in pairs) == k for n, k, pairs in results if pairs != -1)
postconditions.description: For each test case with a solution, the sum of the bitwise AND of all pairs equals k.

postconditions.expression: all(pairs == -1 for n, k, pairs in results if not any(sum(a & b for a, b in pairs) == k for pairs in generate_pairs(n, k)))
postconditions.description: For each test case with no solution, the output is -1.
